narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On December 3, 2024, at approximately 2030 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a gas station in Paw Paw, Michigan, after a clerk called about a man asking for help. The subject stated that he is a citizen of El Salvador without documents.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that in January 2023 a driver hid him under tarps in the cargo bed of a pickup truck that drove through a ranch gate east of Laredo, Texas, while the rest of his group walked across the river and met them later.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notice to Appear.
